photo.caption: Josiah Wedgwood's pottery, a status symbol of consumerism in the late 18th century
photo.description: "Horse Frightened by a Lion (Episode A)," by the English potter and sculptor Josiah Wedgwood and Thomas Bentley, after George Stubbs. Modeled in 1780. Solid blue jasper with white relief, shallow oval. 10 inches x 16 inches (25.4 cm x 40.6 cm). Courtesy of the Paul Mellon Collection, Yale Center for British Art, Yale University, New Haven, Connecticut.
